notes.semetey-1-2013:p0109:b003:l023: Үрбүз printed proper geographical name preserved Urbuz, three summer pastures; no speculative correction to river name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0109:b004:l022: коңгурап low closed-mouth weeping, exact Yudakhin коңгура-; not literal ringing a bell.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0109:b004:l026: маталып bent, Yudakhin матал- reflexive мата-II with bent elders example; ribs bend with grief, not ribs broken by new blow.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0109:b004:l029: өлбө and калба counterfactual mourning wishes, rendered if only and would that, not command to resurrect.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0109:b004:l037: кесир primary Yudakhin disrespect/arrogance and ill fortune resulting from it. Haughty retained as speakers sharp characterization beside protection of widow, not silently turned into innocent unfortunate.
